paragraphs: As a mark of respect to the memory of Hon. Marcus A. Hanna, late senator from the state of Ohio, it is hereby ordered that all federal offices in Ohio be closed during the hours of the funeral tomorrow, Friday, the 19th instant.
eo-254.collated_against: Fresno Evening Democrat, February 18, 1904, 'Hanna Funeral Train' (California Digital Newspaper Collection), 2026-10-12
eo-254.notes: Base text is Wikisource's (which cites no printed source); the newspaper prints the sentence word for word under a Washington, February 18 dateline, without the signature and date line, which are Wikisource's. No official printing seen. No seal (executive order).
